title: Canonical quotient maps and completed-coefficient derived reductions
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, the chosen uniformizer $\varpi$, and the finite rings $A_n=R/\varpi^{n+1}$ for $n\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $W$ be a scheme and use its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Write $B_n=(A_n)_W$, $\widehat R_W=\varprojlim_n B_n$, and $\pi_n:\widehat R_W\to B_n$ for the completed coefficient sheaf and its projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. For $n\leq m$, define $q_{m,n}:A_m\to A_n$ as the quotient factor induced by the identity of $R$, and $\bar q_{m,n}:B_m\to B_n$ as its constant sheafification. The projections obey $\bar q_{m,n}\circ\pi_m=\pi_n$, including $m=n$. Write $\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}$ and $\operatorname{Res}_n$ for exact restriction of scalars along $\bar q_{m,n}$ and $\pi_n$, respectively, on module sheaves and their derived categories [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define $c_{m,n}:\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Res}_n$ as the canonical composition comparison, induced by identity on underlying sections, of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower] applied to the displayed projection equality. For $K\in D(\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_W))$, put $K_n=L_nK=K\otimes^L_{\widehat R_W}B_n$ [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. Use the normalized adjunction $L_n\dashv\operatorname{Res}_n$ and its unit $\eta_n$ from [lem-weil-derived-scalar-extension-restriction-adjunction]. Define the quotient-induced reduction map $\rho_{m,n}:K_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$ as the inverse adjunction image under $L_m\dashv\operatorname{Res}_m$ of $K\xrightarrow{\eta_n}\operatorname{Res}_nK_n\xrightarrow{c_{m,n}^{-1}}\operatorname{Res}_m\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}K_n$. Thus the map uses the actual quotient and the normalized tensor unit, rather than an arbitrary choice of a morphism.
